full_judgment: 17. The fundamental and basic presumption in the administration of Criminal law and justice delivery system is the innocence of the alleged accused and till the charges are proved beyond reasonable doubt on the basis of clear, credible or unimpeachable evidence, the questions of inducting or punishing an accused does not arise.
